title: A partner's open question before a booked call

objects.subject: Cleanwave x Nimbus - webhook question
objects.body:
Hi Arjun,

Great chatting at the meetup. As discussed, our API docs are at the link below. Could you confirm whether your agent can read our webhook events before we meet? I have booked Thursday 9 Oct, 4 pm IST.

Cheers,
Varun Iyer
Founder, Cleanwave
